title: Airy Delicate Greek Spinach Spanakopita
description: A cultured and pillowy Greek dish featuring jasmine rice, perfect for a brunch mood, this flexitarian-friendly spanakopita is a delicious and savory treat. It combines the freshness of spinach with the warmth of feta cheese and the comfort of jasmine rice.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked jasmine rice, chopped spinach, crumbled feta cheese, salt, and black pepper, and stir until they are well combined.
Add the cooked onion and garlic mixture to the bowl and stir until they are fully incorporated.
In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs and water, and then add this mixture to the bowl with the rice and spinach mixture, and stir until everything is well combined.
Unroll the phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
Spoon the rice and spinach mixture onto one piece of the phyllo dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the phyllo dough over the filling to form a triangle, and brush the top of the spanakopita with a little bit of olive oil.
Place the spanakopita on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 35 minutes, or until the phyllo dough is golden brown.
